transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my lower back, mainly. I've been getting a stiff aching pain across it, worse on the left side, and it's been troubling me for a bit now.
When did you first notice it?
It came on a little while back, I'm not too sure exactly when.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
Bending down makes it worse, and getting out of the car is a struggle. It eases off if I lie on my side, and a hot water bottle helps too.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It's a stiff, aching sort of pain, though now and then I get a sharp twinge.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's across my lower back, more on the left, and it spreads into my left buttock. It doesn't go down past my knee, though.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
It's not too bad — it comes and goes, but it's a nuisance more than anything.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It's there most of the time, but some moments it's easier than others.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
No, nothing much else. I've not had any trouble passing water or controlling my bowels, and no numbness down below or in the groin.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I've got type 2 diabetes. I had a similar bout of back pain years ago as well, that settled with some physio.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
Just some tablets for my diabetes, and I've been taking some painkillers from the chemist since this started.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, I don't have any allergies that I know of.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
I can't do any of my gardening at the moment, and I even need help putting my socks on.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
Yes, I'm worried I might have slipped a disc, and whether I need a scan for it.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
